decisionsTitle: «Spune-ne ceva» chooses with cards and icons, and the safety form says it is for women (amending §676)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-09, looking at QA's `/ro/contact/spune-ne` on a phone:** «Vreau niște chestii mai frumos vizuale și iconițe. Siguranță devine "Siguranță pentru Femei" cu subtitlul, știm că în alergarea ca femeie aduce niște extra provocări... Sau combină Sugestii și Reclamații I guess. Sau zi "Girl Zone" să nu pară așa că mama ce fatalai sunt Brașov Runners».

Step 1 of the wizard (§676) was four plain radios with a grey hint under each — correct, and the plainest thing on the site. The safety branch read «Siguranță» / «Pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi. Confidențial.», which reads as if something had already gone wrong.

**Decision.**

- **Cards.** Each branch offered is a card: its glyph on a 40-pixel rounded tile, the branch's name in bold, its hint under it. One column on a phone, two from 600 pixels, the phone's gap `DENSITY.gapSm`. A chosen card is outlined two pixels wide in the primary colour on a light primary tint, whichever branch it is; only the glyph's tile carries a tint of its branch's own — the primary colour for the three ordinary forms, the secondary for the women's, so it reads as a place of its own rather than a fourth complaint. Every card is at least 44 pixels tall and the whole card is the tap target.
- **Still a native form.** Each card is a `<label>` around the real `<input type="radio" name="tip">`, left visible at the card's right edge and painted in the primary colour (`accent-color`), so the keyboard, a screen reader and a page with no JavaScript behave exactly as with the plain radios before; the card's outline and tint follow `:checked` through CSS `:has()` alone. «Continuă» is the same `GET`, `?tip=` the same step, the first branch (or the one `?tip=` named) checked by default. No client island, no dependency. The fieldset is `src/modules/feedback/ui/BranchChoice.tsx`, a Server Component.
- **One glyph per branch, `FEEDBACK_BRANCH_GLYPH`** (`src/modules/feedback/ui/branch-glyph.ts`), drawn on step 1's card and again beside the branch's title on step 2, so the picture a visitor chose is the one above the form she fills: «Cum a fost» a runner (`DirectionsRun`), «O sugestie» a light bulb (`LightbulbOutlined`), «O reclamație» the triangle that says something is wrong (`ReportProblemOutlined`), «Siguranță pentru femei» a heart outline (`FavoriteBorder`). The heart over the shield, of the two the brief allowed: a shield says defence and danger, the very tone the owner asked to lose; a heart says the club cares, and it is not the hand holding a heart the event pages already use for a donation (`VolunteerActivism`, `events/ui/glyphs.ts`). The glyphs are decoration (`aria-hidden`); the words carry the meaning.
- **«Siguranță pentru femei».** The name says whom it is for; the hint says why without fear: «Știm că alergatul, ca femeie, vine cu provocări în plus. Dacă ceva te-a făcut să nu te simți în siguranță la noi, spune-ne — confidențial.» / "We know running as a woman comes with extra challenges. If something made you feel unsafe with us, tell us — confidentially." The form's heading takes the same name, the backoffice switch reads «Siguranță pentru femei (confidențial)», and the door's sentence on `/contact`, when this form is the only one offered (`doorIntroKey`), becomes «Un formular confidențial pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi.» / "A confidential form for women who did not feel safe with us." — amending BR-REQ-070-04 criterion 30.
- **What does not move.** The email's subject stays `SAFETY_SUBJECT`, «Mesaj confidențial de pe site»: it names nobody and nothing, on purpose (§676). The privacy notice's template still calls the form „Siguranță” (`legal-documents/templates/privacy-notice.ts`), left alone because any change there asks the club to approve the notice again for a word; the email's footer («Trimis prin formularul confidențial „Siguranță” al site-ului») keeps the same word as the notice, until the owner wants it aligned.

**Refused.**

- **Merging «O sugestie» and «O reclamație».** Each has its own switch, its own recipient and its own email subject (§676); merging them is a settings and email change, not a visual one, and the owner offered it as an alternative («sau»). Kept apart.
- **«Girl Zone».** An English name on a Romanian page, and a playful one for the one form whose reader is a single designated person; «Siguranță pentru femei» with a warm subtitle answers the same worry.
changelogLine: - **«Spune-ne ceva» chooses with cards and icons** — each kind of message is a card with its own picture, and the picture stays beside the form's title; still a plain form with its radio, working without JavaScript. The safety form is now «Siguranță pentru femei», with a warmer subtitle. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given two or more branches offered, when step 1 of `/<locale>/contact/spune-ne` renders, then each branch is a card — a `<label>` around a visible native radio named `tip` whose value is the branch's slug, the branch's glyph from `FEEDBACK_BRANCH_GLYPH` on a 40-pixel tile, its name and its hint — at least 44 pixels tall, with no sideways scroll at 320 pixels; the first branch (or the one in `?tip=`) is checked, a press anywhere on a card chooses it, a chosen card is outlined in the primary colour, and «Continuă» is the same `GET` with `?tip=<slug>`, working without JavaScript (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a branch's form on step 2, then its title carries the same glyph tile as its card on step 1; «Cum a fost» is a runner, «O sugestie» a light bulb, «O reclamație» a warning triangle and «Siguranță pentru femei» a heart outline, every glyph `aria-hidden` (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The safety branch is named «Siguranță pentru femei» / "Safety for women", with the hint «Știm că alergatul, ca femeie, vine cu provocări în plus. Dacă ceva te-a făcut să nu te simți în siguranță la noi, spune-ne — confidențial.» / "We know running as a woman comes with extra challenges. If something made you feel unsafe with us, tell us — confidentially."; its email's subject stays «Mesaj confidențial de pe site» (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amending criterion 30's door sentence: with «Siguranță pentru femei» the only branch offered, the door's sentence on `/contact` names that form alone — «Un formular confidențial pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi.» / "A confidential form for women who did not feel safe with us." — never the three that are not there (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the feedback choice is cards with icons
